events.title: The Fourth Crusade lays siege to the Christian city of Zara
events.description: Crusaders unable to pay the Venetians for their fleet arrived at Zara on the Dalmatian coast and besieged it for Venice. The city fell within two weeks, and Pope Innocent III excommunicated the crusaders.
events.html: Crusaders unable to pay the Venetians for their fleet arrived at Zara on the Dalmatian coast and besieged it for Venice. The city fell within two weeks, and Pope Innocent III excommunicated the crusaders.

events.title: Raden Wijaya is crowned the first king of Majapahit
events.description: Raden Wijaya, who had used a Mongol expedition sent by Kublai Khan to defeat his rivals and then driven the Mongol forces out, was crowned the first ruler of Majapahit in eastern Java, taking the name Kertarajasa Jayawardhana.

events.title: Sultan Murad II defeats the crusaders at Varna
events.description: The Ottoman army of Sultan Murad II defeated a crusading army of Hungarians, Poles and Wallachians near the Black Sea port of Varna. King Władysław III of Poland and Hungary was killed, and the defeat ended the Crusade of Varna.

events.title: Supporters of Sigismund III Vasa are executed in the Åbo Bloodbath
events.description: In the final phase of Sweden's civil war, supporters of the deposed King Sigismund III Vasa were publicly executed at Turku (Åbo) in Finland. Duke Charles of Södermanland, the later Charles IX, was crushing the last resistance to his rule.

events.title: The Continental Congress creates the Continental Marines
events.description: The Continental Congress resolved to raise two battalions of Marines. The date is celebrated as the birthday of the United States Marine Corps.
events.html: The Continental Congress resolved to raise two battalions of Marines. The date is celebrated as the birthday of the United States Marine Corps.

events.title: Henry Morton Stanley finds David Livingstone at Ujiji
events.description: The journalist Henry Morton Stanley located the missionary-explorer David Livingstone at Ujiji, on Lake Tanganyika, by Stanley's own dating. His reported greeting, 'Dr Livingstone, I presume?', became famous.

events.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk dies in Istanbul
events.description: Atatürk, founder and first president of the Republic of Turkey, died at Dolmabahçe Palace. Turks still pause at 9.05 in the morning on this day to mark the moment of his death.
events.html: Atatürk, founder and first president of the Republic of Turkey, died at Dolmabahçe Palace. Turks still pause at 9.05 in the morning on this day to mark the moment of his death.

events.title: The freighter Edmund Fitzgerald sinks in Lake Superior
events.description: The ore carrier SS Edmund Fitzgerald sank in a violent storm on Lake Superior with the loss of all 29 crew. It is the largest ship lost on the Great Lakes.
